intent: Green the pre-existing red main clippy baseline (redundant-reference-in-format). Rust 1.97's clippy lint clippy::useless_borrows_in_formatting fires on two redundant references passed to format! that the older toolchain did not flag, so `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` (the Lint & Unit Tests CI job) fails on main and blocks unrelated PRs. This change removes exactly those two redundant `&` sigils: `&certificate_id.to_string()[..8].to_uppercase()` -> `certificate_id.to_string()[..8].to_uppercase()` in amos-education, and `&body.response` -> `body.response` in amos-autoresearch. Minimal, no refactor, no behavior change, no lint-config change — the two edits clippy itself prescribed via its `help: remove the redundant &` suggestion.
policy_refs: CI job: Lint & Unit Tests (cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings)

validation_plan.reason: The exact CI command that was failing on main; must exit 0 after the fix. Reproduced locally under the CI toolchain (Rust 1.97.0) to confirm both errors are cleared.
Confirm the two edits leave formatting clean; fmt is a CI gate step.
Confirm the two edited crates still build and their unit tests pass — the changes drop a redundant borrow only, no semantics change.

execution_evidence.output_ref: Under Rust 1.97.0 toolchain (matching CI @stable): before = 2 errors (useless_borrows_in_formatting in certification.rs:88 and mutator.rs:372); after fix = Finished, exit 0.
amos-education: 2 passed; amos-autoresearch built and tested; 0 failed.

result_summary: Removed exactly two redundant `&` sigils flagged by clippy::useless_borrows_in_formatting on Rust 1.97 — amos-education/src/tools/certification.rs:88 and amos-autoresearch/src/darwinian/mutator.rs:372 — greening `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` on main. Verified under the CI toolchain (1.97.0): clippy exits 0, cargo fmt --check is clean, and cargo test --lib for both edited crates passes. No refactor, no behavior change, no lint-config change.
